_what_this_is: A real-system set for the internal sweep. Copy it, point the commands at your agents, and run: python3 -m npbench_c.sweep.cli campaigns/<id> --systems <your-config>.json  -- which is what turns the readiness gate's five PENDING checks into measurements. npbench_c.sweep.systems documents what the loader refuses and why.
_placeholders: {prompt} is the rendered task (also at PROMPT.md in the working directory), {submission} is the directory to write the report into, {sandbox} and {campaign} are available too. Braces that are not one of those four are left alone, so a JSON literal or ${VAR} in a command is safe.
_timeouts: Not configured here: the timeout comes from each campaign's declared budgets.wall_clock_minutes, so no system is silently given more wall clock than the campaign budgeted. A timeout_s below that is honoured; one above it is clamped.
